$comment: NOT RENDERED. wave-ci reads only .buildkite/wave-ci.json (its top-level keys are a closed set). parked_jobs lists every GitHub Actions job that has no running Buildkite step yet, with the reason and the blocker, so nothing is dropped. To port one, write its step script (and verbatim gates) once the blocker lands, add the step to extra_steps in wave-ci.json, and move its row in .buildkite/README.md. This is a PUBLIC repo: a step that needs a secret also needs Jake's decision on a public-repo secrets row, which does not exist today.

parked_jobs.reason: `npm ci` installs @wave-av/spoke-chassis and @wave-av/container-pool from GitHub Packages, which answers 403 (billing block). The step would fail every build at install.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: the self-hosted private npm registry (ruling WGL-0928-18), with @wave-av/container-pool in its import list, plus a read credential for this public repo's pipeline (Jake's decision)

parked_jobs.reason: advisory A/B benchmark. It checks out its harness from a private repository with CONFORMANCE_REPO_PAT on pull_request builds only, and posts a sticky PR comment with a GitHub write token. A public repo's step may hold a secret only when it needs it on main, and this one never runs on main. Its two cold source builds of ffmpeg also exceed the 60-minute step cap (GitHub allows 120). The tools are not the blocker: the CI image has Docker rootless with buildx, ffmpeg 6.1.1 and Go 1.27.1.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: Jake's decision on a PR-build credential for a public repo (or a public harness), a GitHub write path for the comment (RUN-231, wave-ci#132), and a persistent build cache that fits the step cap

parked_jobs.reason: GitHub-only plumbing: it reports whether CONFORMANCE_REPO_PAT is provisioned so `bench` can no-op. It has no meaning without `bench`.

only writes the main-branch recipe's layers into the GitHub Actions cache (type=gha) so PR bench runs start warm. Buildkite guests are disposable and have no shared layer cache, so the build would warm nothing; a cold build of the recipe (AVM + ffmpeg from source) also exceeds the 60-minute step cap.
parked_jobs.blocked_on: a persistent build cache for CI guests, and `bench` being ported

parked_jobs.reason: production deploy on push to main (wrangler deploy with Cloudflare credentials). Deploy and publish jobs are not ported until Jake names them.

AI PR review that posts comments (GitHub write token, model API key) and answers issue_comment slash commands.
